description: The Feb 21 Port-au-Prince march has a body-verified date, route, and demand, but the opened report provides no attendance count; captions show only partial views. Eligibility remains pending threshold.
required_followup: Seek an independent contemporaneous count or description sufficient to establish whether at least 50 people assembled.

description: Haiti Standard describes a separate crowd supporting former mayor Ralph Youri Chevry during the Feb 21 march. It gives no count or expressed demand; the former mayor had been arrested in the Dominican Republic after a notice issued by Haitian police, so the crowd's state target cannot be inferred.
required_followup: Find a contemporaneous report stating the crowd's demand, intended target, and approximate attendance before considering a separate candidate.

description: Search leads refer to opposition demonstrations demanding President Moïse leave office coming to a head on Feb 7, but no body-reviewed source identifies a specific crowd, location, or attendance. Keep the reported date provisional and separate it from the alleged-coup arrests and later February actions.
required_followup: Review the local Gazette Haiti and UN/IACHR source bodies; establish the gathering, actual location, state-directed demand, and whether at least 50 people assembled.

description: Several search-only leads describe a Feb 10 anti-government march in Port-au-Prince; one claims hundreds. No original report body has been inspected, and reports about police action cannot be coded from snippets.
required_followup: Review contemporaneous reports and their written-story origins; verify the count and date, then separately code protester violence and each state-response dimension.

description: Search-only sources describe a Feb 11 Carrefour protest over arrests in the Dabrézil case. “Dozens” is not a precise count and does not establish whether the 50-person threshold was met.
required_followup: Review the contemporaneous Carrefour reports and any original Prensa Latina story; verify attendance, target, source relationships, and event-specific response.

description: A search-only commentary describes hundreds of students in Delmas in the morning of Feb 13 and a larger afternoon march. Treat these as possible distinct assemblies; the original post/report and their relationship to Feb 10 coverage have not been reviewed.
required_followup: Review the original social-media post and contemporaneous reporting to verify date, location, count, demand, and whether the morning and afternoon gatherings were separate.

description: Search leads describe a Feb 14 Port-au-Prince march and possible coordinated actions in several provincial cities. Attendance claims vary and include city-specific or organizer-attributed estimates; do not combine them until each site and source origin is checked.
required_followup: Review contemporary full reports and any original organizer or agency statements; map each estimate to its place, time, and attribution, and identify shared or syndicated reporting.

description: A Feb 15 Al Jazeera search result says protests continued but includes a photograph caption dated Feb 14. The available search lead does not establish a new Feb 15 assembly or whether it describes the Feb 14 action.
required_followup: Inspect the article body and caption provenance before assigning a separate Feb 15 event or treating it as a continuation.

description: Search-only sources date a Carrefour demonstration seeking release of people detained in the Dabrézil case to Feb 18. Attendance is not shown, and it must remain distinct from the Feb 11 action unless evidence establishes identity.
required_followup: Review both local reports for attendance, precise target, common origin, and evidence distinguishing the Feb 18 gathering from Feb 11.

description: Search-only coverage says FLA students protested on Feb 22 for release of a kidnapped fellow student. It does not establish whether the demand targeted Haitian authorities, kidnappers, or both; crowd size and location are also unresolved.
required_followup: Review the contemporaneous report and any original announcement; establish the demand target and whether at least 50 students assembled.

description: Search results describe a Feb 28 march in Port-au-Prince and several provincial cities. Reported crowd sizes include local estimates and an organizer-attributed claim of over 1.5 million in the metropolitan area plus provincial crowds. None has been verified in a full body; do not pool across places.
required_followup: Review post-event reports and organizer statements; keep metropolitan and provincial estimates separate, record each source’s attribution, and test whether the event was coordinated across sites.

description: Search leads describe a Feb 1–2 general strike and workplace/economic disruption. A strike, closed businesses, or road blockage alone does not establish a qualifying public assembly; one search lead mentions clashes near Champ de Mars without a crowd count.
required_followup: Review the strike-day reports for an actual public gathering, simultaneous attendance, demand directed to Haiti’s government, and a distinct protest episode; create a candidate only if evidence supports it.

description: The Feb 25 search leads concern a maternity-service work stoppage at Justinien University Hospital in Cap-Haïtien. They do not establish a public assembly; workforce size is not protest attendance.
required_followup: Review the original reports for a distinct public gathering and count; do not treat the workplace strike alone as an assembly.

description: A Feb 12 search lead reports a court-clerks union announcing a general strike after a clerk’s suspension. The announcement does not establish that workers or supporters assembled publicly.
required_followup: Review the report and any execution-day coverage for a public gathering, turnout, state-directed demand, and date.

description: Open-web searches covered broad February windows and targeted dates, French and Haitian Creole terms, and local, international, government, and human-rights leads. They are not a systematic LexisNexis search; the result set leaves unresolved days, localities, sectors, language variants, and source access. Search results did not establish an event-free interval.
required_followup: Continue targeted local/regional and rights-source searches, seek permitted full-text access for saved leads, and compare with systematic archives if available; do not infer absence from current search coverage.

description: Search-only leads suggest repeated Sunday mobilizations on Feb 14, Feb 21, and Feb 28. They represent different dates and should not be combined into one continuous gathering; campaign continuity and each physical event’s start/end remain unresolved.
required_followup: Review sources for each date, distinguish recurring campaign calls from physical assemblies, and establish the event end rather than using publication date or month-end.

description: The Feb 14 Gazette Haiti body attempt was withheld after the immediate pre-request recheck at 2026-10-10T12:18:15.218Z found 2 changed paths among 229 inputs: Honduras and Hungary February 2021 source ledgers. The saved R005 receipt/manual review are stale evidence only; no page request occurred.
required_followup: For any later attempt, obtain a new exact-URL receipt, re-review the complete matching publisher/origin corpus, then immediately recheck the full input path/hash set before requesting the page.
